subject: general
question: According to Census 2011 which Indian State/UT has no Scheduled Tribe?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puducherry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to Census 2011, **Puducherry** is the only Indian Union Territory/State that does not have any Scheduled Tribe (ST) population.
 
• Scheduled Tribes (STs) are officially recognized groups that are historically disadvantaged and protected under the Constitution of India.
 
• While other states and UTs have populations classified under Scheduled Tribes, Puducherry stands out as an exception with zero representation.
 
• In contrast, states like Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand have a significantly high proportion of Scheduled Tribe populations.
 
• This distinction highlights the unique demographic composition of Puducherry compared to other regions in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scheduled Tribes (STs):**

 
 
• Scheduled Tribes are communities recognized by the Constitution of India under Article 342 due to their social, economic, and cultural disadvantages.
 
• These tribes are listed in the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution and are eligible for special benefits and protections.
 
 
 
• **Census 2011:**
 
 
• The Census provides detailed demographic, social, and economic data on India's population.
 
• It is conducted every 10 years by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India.
 
 
 
• **Comparison of ST Populations:**
 
 
• States like Mizoram, Nagaland, and Meghalaya have over 85% ST population, while others like Punjab and Delhi have minimal representation.
 
 
 
• **Demographics of Puducherry:**
 
 
• Puducherry is a Union Territory with a majority Tamil-speaking population.
 
• Its demographic composition is unique due to the absence of Scheduled Tribes.
